name: Tolla
role: head herder, dada of the high grazing

lines.text: A goat carries what it agreed to carry and not a handful more. Bhar, we say -- a load with consent in it. Put a thing on a goat without asking and it will lie down in the road and be right.
The top step is the goats' in the dry months. It always has been. The University calls it ornamental, and I let them.
The wind comes over the edge up here like a hand. It took my father's tent. It has taken better things than that.

A snake leaves its skin on the top step every summer and the goats walk round it. Oil it twice and it turns that wind better than any wool. My father had a mantle of them. The wind took the tent and left him the mantle.

When somebody has been up to the snowfield, we boil the milk down half a day until it is the colour of sand, and set it in little clay cones packed in the ice with a fist of salt over them. Kulfi. Bring me milk and a lump of that ice and I will show you. It does not keep and the ice does not either, so it is made up here or not at all.
You stood in it. On purpose. -- Then you know it is not only taking.

notes:
Drafted 27 September 2026 for the owner to rewrite. The high grazing's dada: he decides which goats go on which step, and nobody else has wanted the job. Would settle, if something up here were built to stay.

Teaches kulfi (the owner, 4 October 2026): the plateau's one sweet, made only on the Narmada because the ice is the snowfield's. The game holds the recipe to the Narmada with `made_on`; Tolla is the only one who shows it.
